fsm_hints_transmitter.name: TX_IDLE
fsm_hints_transmitter.description: No word queued; bus held at NULL state (0 V differential). Inter-word gap is NULL-held by default.

fsm_hints_transmitter.name: TX_GAP
fsm_hints_transmitter.description: Holding NULL for at least 4 bit-times before starting a new word (≥ 40 µs at 100 kbit/s).

fsm_hints_transmitter.name: TX_LABEL
fsm_hints_transmitter.description: Transmit bits 1-8 (Label) MSB-first within the label field. Each bit drives HI or LO for the first half of the bit-time, then NULL for the second half (BRZ).

fsm_hints_transmitter.name: TX_DATA
fsm_hints_transmitter.description: Transmit bits 11-29 (19-bit Data field) per chosen encoding (BNR / BCD / Discrete; mixed permitted).

fsm_hints_transmitter.name: TX_SSM
fsm_hints_transmitter.description: Transmit bits 30-31 (Sign/Status Matrix) per BCD/BNR/Discrete SSM table.

fsm_hints_transmitter.name: TX_PARITY
fsm_hints_transmitter.description: Compute odd parity over bits 1..31; drive bit 32 accordingly (0 or 1) to make the total number of 1-bits in the 32-bit word odd.

fsm_hints_transmitter.name: TX_RETURN_TO_IDLE
fsm_hints_transmitter.description: After bit 32, return to NULL for ≥ 4 bit-times before optionally starting the next word.

fsm_hints_receiver.name: RX_IDLE
fsm_hints_receiver.description: Bus at NULL state; waiting for first HI-or-LO bit-half transition that marks the start of bit 1 of a new word.

fsm_hints_receiver.name: RX_GAP_DETECT
fsm_hints_receiver.description: Counted ≥ 4 bit-times of NULL since the last bit 32 → ready to accept the next word's bit 1.

fsm_hints_receiver.name: RX_BIT_SAMPLE
fsm_hints_receiver.description: On each bit-time, sample line during the first half (HI = 1, LO = 0, NULL = framing error/ambiguous); confirm return-to-NULL in the second half. Recover bit clock from BRZ transitions.

fsm_hints_receiver.name: RX_DESHIFT_WORD
fsm_hints_receiver.description: Accumulate 32 bits into a word register: bits 1..8 → Label; 9..10 → SDI; 11..29 → Data; 30..31 → SSM; 32 → Parity.

fsm_hints_receiver.name: RX_PARITY_CHECK
fsm_hints_receiver.description: Verify odd parity over the 32-bit word; discard or flag on mismatch.

fsm_hints_receiver.name: RX_LABEL_FILTER
fsm_hints_receiver.description: Apply local Label filter (per equipment-type table); accept matched labels, drop unmatched.

fsm_hints_receiver.name: RX_SSM_DECODE
fsm_hints_receiver.description: Decode SSM bits (30-31) per the data representation in use (BCD / BNR / Discrete); attach FW/NCD/FT/NO/sign attribute to the data sample.

synchronization_rules: BRZ self-clocking: each bit-time begins with a HI or LO drive for the first half and returns to NULL for the second half.
The receiver recovers bit clock from the HI→NULL or LO→NULL mid-bit transitions; no separate clock wire is transmitted.
Hard inter-word resynchronization: after a ≥ 4-bit-time NULL gap, the next HI-or-LO drive is the start of bit 1 of a new 32-bit word.
There is no preamble / start bit / stop bit other than the implicit ≥ 4-bit-time NULL framing.
Bit-rate tolerance is bounded by the worst-case BRZ eye opening; in practice ±1 % oscillator tolerance per side is comfortably within margin at 100 kbit/s.
arbitration_rule: Not applicable — ARINC 429 is single-transmitter unidirectional broadcast. No arbitration mechanism exists at the protocol layer. Multi-source avionics networks use a pair of buses (one per direction) or a multi-transmitter extension such as ARINC 629 (TDMA) or ARINC 664 Part 7 (switched deterministic Ethernet / AFDX).
anti_deadlock_rule: Not applicable. Single-transmitter buses cannot deadlock. The transmitter constantly emits either 32-bit words or NULL; receivers are passive monitors with no upstream feedback.
exit_from_reset_or_wakeup: On power-up or reset, the transmitter holds the bus at NULL until its first word is queued, then waits ≥ 4 bit-times before driving bit 1. Receivers stay in RX_IDLE / RX_GAP_DETECT until the first HI-or-LO drive is detected; no handshake or wake-up exchange is defined at the wire-level protocol.
default_signal_state_when_bus_free: NULL state (0 V differential); single transmitter drives both wires to equal potential while idle.
label_filtering_rule: Each receiver implements a local label-acceptance filter (one bit per possible 8-bit octal label, or a CAM/lookup of accepted labels). Labels not in the filter are discarded after parity check. Filter semantics are equipment-specific; the ARINC 429 spec only standardizes the LABEL → meaning assignments per equipment type (Sections 78-116 of ARINC 429 Part 1-17).
